title: Linx Brand Illustration System
summary: A scalable botanical illustration system and custom AI tool for creating consistent brand assets across multiple levels of complexity.
overview: An exploratory engagement for Linx, an AI-native identity security platform. The work began with a homepage audit that identified gaps in the existing visual brand, and developed into a botanical illustration direction and a custom "Linx Brand Illustrator" GPT for generating consistent, on-brand assets. The system was defined across four levels of complexity -- accent elements, spot illustrations, section illustrations, and hero and scene compositions -- with the visual language expanded to include elements like a sunflower, butterfly, dragonfly, ladybug, dandelion, tulip, and poppy, alongside an explored gestural icon direction. Moodboards were assembled and the system was presented to Linx's CPO; AI-assisted output was refined and composited in Figma and Adobe Illustrator.
